“We’ve worked with Niewohner Entities for many years and have always been treated fairly. The relationship is strong and built on trust. They are honest, easy to deal with, and their location makes everything convenient. We also benefit from their wet corn program, which adds real value to our operation.”
Tisthammer Farms
“We’ve been selling corn to Niewohners for the last several years. Its been a great way for us to move bushels at harvest. They’ve had competitive bids, forward contracts and flexible pricing options for unsold bushels without storage costs. They’ve been great to work with, we’re fortunate to have them as a market in our area.”
Justin Frey
“I like that you price corn in thirds and there are no storage fees involved. Anytime I need a check, it is delivered to me in a timely manner. The Niewohner family and their employees are always helpful and kind to work with.”
Eric Frey
